title: Master Lock Elite Padlock
summary: Master Lock Elite Padlock. Enhanced Security, Engineered to Last
body_markdown:
### Enhanced Security, Engineered to Last


The new[Master Lock Elite™ Padlock](https://www.masterlock.com/elite-padlocks) is our toughest lock yet. These premium locks are armored to defend against cutting, picking, pry attempts and severe weather, balancing maximum security with flexibility to provide the best defense for any job, in any environment.


The Elite padlock is made with Cutguard™ technology and features a 5-pin cylinder for maximum security against pick attempts and unauthorized access. Additionally, the *keyed alike convenience* feature allows users to access multiple Elite locks with a single key for easier management and efficiency.


Master Lock Elite padlocks come in a variety of lock body widths and shackle lengths to meet a broad spectrum of needs.
